title: Drawn paper
underHeaderHelp: Unticked (default): the sticky banner at the top is a flat fill of the background colour, the tile covers the rest of the site. Ticked: the tile also goes behind the navigation.
onCardsHelp: Unticked (default): block cards are opaque flat fills that hide the paper. Ticked: the paper is drawn over each card's colour, under its content. Each card can keep its own choice (“Card” menu on the canvas: “Like the site”, “Under the card” or “On the card”).
